resources.title: Data & commands
resources.hintFocused: Data is the AI’s entire input, collected at run time; binding commands lets the AI act on its own.
resources.hintFree: Optional data to preload instead of fetching each run. Without it the AI finds what it needs with tools.
resources.hintReactive: The trigger source’s data is collected automatically; add other devices or commands to consult alongside.

structured.hint: Each field is published as a platform data source usable by dashboards, rules and data-push. Define what to extract, then bind it to inputs via resources.
structured.multiRoundCost: A multi-round conclusion is prose; turning it into fields costs one extra model call at the end of every run.
structured.enumValues: Allowed values, comma-separated (e.g. 正常, 待检, 停线)
structured.guardrailSummary: Guardrails: debounce {{debounce}}s · timeout {{timeout}}s · breaker {{threshold}} · daily cap {{cap}}

advanced.title: Advanced Configuration
advanced.focusedModeDescription: Bind specific resources and actions for fast, precise analysis. Best for monitoring, alerts, data analysis.
advanced.freeModeDescription: LLM freely explores and decides with multi-round tool calling. Best for complex automation and device control.
advanced.structuredModeDescription: Single constrained inference: inputs in, schema-validated fields out as ai:{id}:{field}. Best for meter reading, QC checks, periodic inspection.
advanced.focusedModeRequiresResources: Focused Mode requires at least one resource binding
advanced.priorityHint: Higher runs first when agents compete for a slot (128 = default)
advanced.contextHint: Number of recent conversation turns to load for execution context
advanced.systemPromptPlaceholder: e.g., You are a helpful assistant that analyzes dashboard data...
advanced.systemPromptHint: Override the default agent identity. Leave empty to use the built-in IoT assistant role.
advanced.systemPromptTooLong: System prompt must be 4000 characters or less
advanced.defaultSystemPrompt: You are an intelligent IoT assistant. You monitor edge devices, analyze sensor data, and help users manage their IoT environment. Provide clear, actionable insights based on the data you observe.

workstyle.title: How it works
workstyle.boundDesc: Each run collects the bound data and commands and answers in one pass. Fast, cheap, stable.
workstyle.autoDesc: The AI queries, calls tools and executes commands over multiple rounds until done. For open-ended tasks; slower.
